title: Romantic Private Bus 3 min to Beach
description: This rustic 1 bedroom 1 rustic outdoor bath (please see images) bus combines everything you have always imagined when thinking about your Caribbean vacation. Outdoor living with Amazing Jungle Views. This charming and very private space is the perfect getaway for any couple. An open-air jungle view kitchen and "living room" will make you want to stay forever.The spaceWhat we currently do not have: 1. NO WIFI 2. NO TVWhat we currently provide:- We provide the basic supplies like trash bags and toilet paper to get you started but after that please feel free to drive a minute down the road to Colmado Rodriguez, a small store, for your additional needs. - Queen Bed- Small/Mini fridge for some drinks and other basics- Coffee maker (please bring coffee)- Please bring drinking water.- BBQ with gas provided - no stove- AC- Indoor and outdoor lights - Small dipping pool with fresh water (not heated)- Hot water in shower-Kitchen utensils, plates and cups. No pots and pans provided as there is no stove. We do provide a BBQ and propane gas for cooking. - Single private parking spot-Linens and two towels This space is for one or two Adults Only. If more than two people arrive then you reservation will be cancelled immediately. This very private ROMANTIC BLUE BIRD BUS is a few minutes away from the beach by car. You will find great sandy spots to swim but also one of Puerto Rico's best barreling surf spots in the area during big wave season. If you don't surf then enjoy strolling on the sandy beaches for miles. We will be able to tell you about a few uncrowded local surf spots in the area.Puerto Rico has occasional power outages and water outages. While we try our best to provide backup water and sometimes backup power when possible it is not always available/ we are not always able to provide a generator and if we are able to it can only run from 6pm to about 7am. Please, only book if you are willing to accept this rarely occurring event. And when the hunger hits, drive to the chicken truck a few minutes down the road (...amazing food, ask us where it is...) or jump in the car and drive 8 minutes to Rincon's wide variety of restaurants. Experience excellent authentic Puerto Rican cuisine at the local waterfront restaurant which are only a short 5 minute drive away (GUAYABO TROPICAL). On Sunday's you can drive to the Rincon Farmer's Market and indulge in some of the best and freshest farm food available. There is guided horseback riding on Rincon's hidden trails and beaches, sailing on the "Katarina" sailboat and multiple very professional fishing charter operations. Two of the tennis courts (hard courts) in Rincon are also in decent condition. Or join a large pickle ball group 4 times a week.Rincon also offers the most visited and most colorful art walk on the west coast. Every Thursday artists from all around gather in Rincon to showcase their work. You can always find a treasure to take back from you vacation and on most nights live bands will fill Rincon's streets with local and international vibes.Our Romantic Blue Bird Bus is located on a very private property and boasts beautiful green jungle views.It is only 25 minutes to and from Aguadilla airport (BQN) which makes those early morning arrivals and departures much easier (you will know what we are talking about when you book your flights.)San Juan can be a 1.5-2.5 hour drive away depending on traffic. Flights on Cape Air from San Juan (SJU) to Mayaguez (MAZ) are an option and sometimes start at $50 each way.Guest accesswill be texted before arrival

title: Pura Vida Ocean Beach
description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay in this peaceful, centrally located condo in a gated beachfront community, just 20 steps from the sand.Only 5 minutes from downtown Rincón and 10–15 minutes from some of the area’s best surf.This 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo includes a fully stocked kitchen, A/C, Wi-Fi, board games, beach gear including snorkel equipment, and access to the community pool.The space🔐 Self Check-InA lockbox at the front door allows for convenient 24-hour self check-in. title: Puntas Vista Mountain & Seaside
